procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are LANDSCAPE-GENUINE (raw ~2420x1870 renders read upright directly, no transpose -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/montgomery/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (16/16).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 13); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 14 precincts (11 columns, then SOUTHEAST WINONA/Stewart/WEST WINONA + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the Chancery 3 continuation, Circuit 5's two Places, and the locals. The SEMS row-block split: 'Chancery Court 3-Chancery District 3 Place 1' prints as the LAST header box on p2/p3 and BOTH its candidate rows (Ginger M. Miller, Jay Westfaul) start p4 ahead of Place 2's own section (the Grenada carry pattern). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster seven counties print, names identical; the CoA 1 sections print X position marks on this sheet with values only in Lodi (78/40/96), NORTH WINONA (187/246/404), Nations (43/100/140), Poplar Creek (18/32/45) and Stewart (9/39/42); Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald -- X at Lodi/NORTH WINONA/Nations/Poplar Creek); Chancery Court 3-Chancery District 3 Place 1 (Ginger M. Miller, Jay Westfaul), Place 2 (Sabrina D. Howell), Place 3 (Mitchell M. Lundy Jr.) -- the same Chancery 3 roster Carroll and Grenada print, names identical (third county); Circuit Court 5-Circuit District 05 Place 1 (Joseph H. 'Joey' Loper Jr.) and Place 2 (Alan D. 'Devo' Lancaster) -- the same Circuit 5 roster four counties print, names identical (fifth county). Printed totals: Colom 1805, Hyde-Smith 1796, Pinkins 48, Eller 1786, G. Thompson 1768, Foster 72, Hopson 335, Weddle 457, D. Barnes 727, McDonald 1983, Miller 2205, Westfaul 812, Howell 2705, Lundy 2765, Loper 2780, Lancaster 2821.
operator_rows_note: All 16 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (three precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Miller's, Westfaul's, Howell's, Lundy's, Loper's and Lancaster's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. The X-celled CoA rows supply only the numeric cells plus the printed TOTAL (Hopson 326+9 = 335; Weddle 418+39 = 457; Barnes 685+42 = 727; McDonald 1569+414 = 1983) -- the X-marked blanks become 0 under the row's own printed TOTAL, the established X-cell rule both pages over.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fourteen precinct headers print complete (DUCK HILL, EAST WINONA, KILMICHAEL, Lodi, NORTH DUCK HILL, NORTH KILMICHAEL, NORTH MT PISGAH SWEETHOME, NORTH WINONA, Nations, Poplar Creek, SOUTH WINONA, SOUTHEAST WINONA, Stewart, WEST WINONA -- the sheet's own mixed case kept verbatim).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local section School Board 1-School Board Member District 1 (Lovanda 'Vanna' Farmer, James A. Mims) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Chancery 3's three Places and Circuit 5's two Places print in-county, so the families write Place-qualified labels (matching the other Chancery 3 and Circuit 5 counties).
